description: Unit test class for RetrieveThingStrategy, testing its behavior and correctness in retrieving 'Thing' objects within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: RetrieveThingStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for RetrieveThingStrategy, verifying its behavior in various scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test instance of RetrieveThingStrategy before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that RetrieveThingStrategy instances are immutable.

methods.name: isNotDefinedForDeviantThingIds
methods.description: Tests that the strategy is not defined for invalid or deviant Thing IDs.

methods.name: isNotDefinedIfContextHasNoThing
methods.description: Verifies that the strategy is not defined if the context has no associated Thing.

methods.name: isDefinedIfContextHasThingAndThingIdsAreEqual
methods.description: Confirms that the strategy is defined when the context has a Thing matching the command.

methods.name: retrieveThingFromContextIfCommandHasNoSnapshotRevisionAndNoSelectedFields
methods.description: Tests retrieving a Thing from context when no specific revision or fields are requested.

methods.name: retrieveThingFromContextIfCommandHasNoSnapshotRevisionButSelectedFields
methods.description: Tests retrieving a Thing with specific selected fields.

methods.name: unhandledReturnsThingNotAccessibleException
methods.description: Verifies that the strategy throws the appropriate exception when the Thing is inaccessible.
